setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 through a MIDI device: four trigs on steps 1 to 4 with the notes C, D, E and F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97. Pattern 1 is assigned to channel 1 over steps 1 to 4. The sequencer is stopped, so no note is sounding, and three MIDI ports are connected. The norns shows channel 1's Device screen; the next step opens Song.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press Song (6,8). The Song page opens (Song Playback, SONG 01) and Song is the lit page button. Panic only works from the button of a page you are not on, so every other page button, including Channel (3,8), is a panic button from here.
steps.title: Open the Song page

steps.caption: From Song, hold the Channel button (3,8) for about two seconds, then release it. Panic sends Note Off to the connected MIDI outputs to release stuck notes. This example starts silent, so you hear no change and the screen stays on Song. Panic leaves playback running. Holding the button of the page you are already on does nothing.

provenance.scope: complete original observed 6144-packet panic sweep, with partial snapshot cross-check explicitly recorded
